effects.trigger: creation of a momentary Class-C "Broken Entry" Wormhole
constraints: a Class-C Broken Entry Wormhole is created

evidence.locator: SCP-3001 is a hypothesized paradoxical parallel/pocket "non-dimension" accessible through the creation of a momentary Class-C "Broken Entry" Wormhole.

constraints: at least 40% of an organism's brain remains for the simulated continued operation

evidence.locator: This phenomenon causes matter inside it to decay at an extremely low rate, and damage that would otherwise prove fatal does not impede any biological/electronic function; simulations suggest an organism can lose more than 70% of their body's tissue and still operate normally, as long as at least 40% of the brain remains.

effects.trigger: To prevent further accidental entries into SCP-3001

evidence.locator: To prevent further accidental entries into SCP-3001, all Foundation reality-bending technology will be upgraded/modified with multiple newly developed safeguards to prevent Class-C "Broken Entry" Wormhole creation.
